title: Lena and the Horizon
author: Quentin Delacroix
blurb: Quentin Vane, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
